Frequently asked questions

Answers to common questions about AR360 Studio — 3D viewers, AR previews, billing, and sharing.

What is AR360 Studio?

AR360 Studio lets furniture and product brands upload 3D models, publish interactive viewers, generate QR codes, and track customer engagement across web and mobile AR.

Which file formats are supported?

GLB is the primary format for web and Android AR. USDZ is supported for iOS Quick Look AR. Posters and thumbnails can be JPG, PNG, or WebP.

How do customers view products in AR?

Share the product link or QR code. On supported devices, customers tap View in AR to place the model in their space using the device camera.

Can I embed the viewer on my website?

Yes. Each product includes an embed snippet for Shopify, WooCommerce, or any site that supports iframe embeds.

How does billing work?

Plans include product, storage, and bandwidth limits. You can start on a trial, upgrade from Settings → Billing, and download invoices from the same area.

Where is my data stored?

Product assets are stored in your tenant folder on disk or cloud storage (when configured). Analytics events are stored in your AR360 database account.

Need more help?

Visit the contact page or email support from your dashboard settings.
